invitation.subject: Invitation to {organization} on {brand}
invitation.body: You have been invited to join {organization} on {brand}.

pastDue.subject: Subscription past due: {organization}
pastDue.body: The subscription of {organization} is past due: the paid period ended on {periodEnd} and no new payment has been recorded.
pastDue.nextStep: Without a recorded payment, the subscription will be suspended on {date}; the customer will then have read-only access.
pastDue.nextStepUnknown: Without a recorded payment, the subscription may be suspended.

suspended.subject: Subscription suspended: {organization}
suspended.body: The subscription of {organization} was suspended for lack of payment of the period that ended on {periodEnd}.
suspended.access: The customer keeps read and export access, without new changes. Recording the payment reactivates the subscription.

aiKeyBackup.subject: The AI key of {workspace} failed
aiKeyBackup.body: The AI key used by {agent} in {workspace} failed (invalid, revoked, out of credit or at the provider's limit). Meanwhile, the platform only finishes the conversations that were already open, with a courtesy model that does not count toward your usage. New conversations are not answered.
aiKeyBackup.nextStep: Replace or test the key by {date}; without a fix, the agent will be paused.

aiKeyPaused.subject: AI agent paused in {workspace}
aiKeyPaused.body: {agent} in {workspace} was paused because the AI key was not fixed within 24 hours.
aiKeyPaused.nextStep: The backup ended on {date}. Replace and test the key, then turn the agent back on.

emailTest.subject: Test e-mail from {brand}
emailTest.body: This is a test e-mail sent from the e-mail settings of {brand}. If you got it, sending works.

serviceModeRequest.subject: {partner} asks to manage {organization}
serviceModeRequest.body: {partner} asked to move {organization} to the managed mode. Only the company owner can approve.
serviceModeRequest.scope: In the managed mode, the managing team sees and operates the whole workspace: AI agents (GUIDS), campaigns, reviews, CRM, conversations and settings. The company's AI key stays yours alone.
serviceModeRequest.back: You can go back to the standard mode at any time, in Settings › Service mode.
serviceModeRequest.expires: The link can be used once and is valid until {date}.

workspaceDeletionScheduled.subject: Deletion of the workspace {workspace} scheduled
workspaceDeletionScheduled.body: The deletion of the workspace {workspace} was requested. From now on none of its services work: channels, AI agents, jobs, API, MCP, public pages and notices.
workspaceDeletionScheduled.nextStep: The data will be erased for good on {date}. Until then, the owner can cancel the deletion in the console.

workspaceDeletionReminder.subject: 7 days left before {workspace} is deleted
workspaceDeletionReminder.body: The workspace {workspace} will be deleted for good on {date}, with all its data.
workspaceDeletionReminder.nextStep: To keep the workspace, the owner can cancel the deletion in the console until that date.

workspaceDeletionCanceled.subject: Deletion of {workspace} canceled
workspaceDeletionCanceled.body: The deletion of the workspace {workspace} was canceled and its services work again.
workspaceDeletionCanceled.nextStep: Check the channels and AI agents of the workspace in the console.

workspaceDeletionCompleted.subject: Workspace {workspace} deleted
workspaceDeletionCompleted.body: The workspace {workspace} was deleted for good, with its data, as requested.
workspaceDeletionCompleted.nextStep: This is the last notice about it. The deletion was due on {date}.
